book.name: 1 TESALONIKA
book.title: IGI NAMBA WAN PAULO MENE TESALONIKA EMO DUBU ENO GAENA

content: Dubo beingtire nao okowata, pewayero nao.

Otao mani nana, na Tuwa Yesu eno yero niye eno ge ewiya sinasani ge osina zo eyero sana nigipu. Uritira gera nao ninae mene Tuwa Bayau otao yaise susuwa sero gipero ayewangne, dekaongka auna gege iwaing nowa. Arata nao awiya tau tataware yero naese sinenane.
Tuwa Yesura bera wini ge serota sero ayewangne awiya oko kau nowa.
Tuwa Bayau nung eyero sinoiya, “Dubo pewayaore neupu.” Pewayero naora susuwa eyao ara: Kuma yao duwaese.
Ninae-una atu mani seka ena awong bauno atari yero giro awong tani iwaing pewayao emo baunona benaungna atu nowa amimene bauno ataese.
Dubo-dubo nasani atao awiya emo diga Tuwa Bayau oko gao yero nowa amimene ayero nowa.
Zo mene gazao ge awiya yau seuno otao nuna-una bauno ugaing oko yaise. Tuwa nung nona auna abena pugairo aung yariniya. Nae ge awiya gitau yemaoko mena niye eno sero gipero ayewangne ara.
Name dubo beingtire nanenese okowata, dubo pewayaore nanenese Tuwa Bayau mene name yau sena.
Arare zo mene ge awiya awang sariniya, awiya nung amimene emora ge okowata, Tuwa Bayau nung Oweno nuna niye eno pugatinoi pupunowa auna ge awang sariniya.
Dubo bayaore nasani buro tau-tataware yero yao.
Niye ge nigao mene dubo mene mono wina-pung yaese noeno aune yanakana sarinenine? Tuwa Bayau nung nuka nutope dubora mono wina-pung yaese susuwa sero gipero ayena ara.
Ayero yenu niye Masedonia provinsra napo sero ge nigao atu nowa awong dubora mono pupunasani nowa. Arata saineba. Nupema seka susuuno kasa yaise sinenane.
Anasani ge zo eyero serota sero nenane. Niye dubo monone neupu. Nona ninae gege diya yepu. Wawong mene buro yero puro mininasani neupu.
Ayero naese sewangne, noeno okowata, niye ayero nasani digara benaungna dora botiyo aung kara naya gaya iwaing yaise.
Yesu kasa yaora be nuna auna ge.
Otao mani, niye mamagayao ninae-una susuwa kau yero diga emo tumo diyao aung amimene dubo gazinoi zi saore yo amaore yero nowa niye ayero yao eno sanane nigipu.
Name Yesu magayero iropuna ge awiya iniro taka sero nonane. Arare deka ayero ge ewiya ganane me yae. Yesu tumo diro nema mamagayero nowa awong awiya Tuwa Bayau mene Yesu aune dema puro bariniya.
Arata zo awiya Tuwara bera ge awiya niye eno sanane. Tawingna etu mitanane Tuwa kasa yai aune name mamagayao awong awiya daigao ine teng oko.

Noeno okowata, Tuwa Bayaura ge bewing tore kasanai aune angelora gitau yao ge sinai be aune Tuwa nuka nune uritira atu wosariniya. Wosai Kristo tumo diro nawe mamagayewa awong amimene gitau iropari neya.
Iropaya seka nenane amimene awong aune dema bautunanane bereze mene name mena puro witai towang atu Tuwa tamari nenane. Ayero yero Tuwa aune dema mitao gege mitari nenane.
Arare niye ge awiya otao mani aune sero nigiro nasani wina soreung nasani dubo monone neupu.
